source_snapshot.procedure: Run `ipmitool sdr elist`, physically remove and insert a module, observe the sensor status change and verify corresponding SEL records; source clears logs first.
source_snapshot.criteria: Temperature changes normally; settings including SDR type match SPEC; SEL records every threshold event; the system performs the specified threshold response such as fan-speed change or shutdown; all STATUS_FAN1~16 pass.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL claims raw or implementation-specific bytes are missing. It does not resolve 1~N versus 1~16, distinguish discrete fan presence from thermal thresholds, or control physical cooling risk.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED correctly identifies the population and signal contradictions plus physical risk. The conflict can be resolved without choosing away coverage by a union applicability matrix and separate status, normal-thermal and threshold-response checkpoints.

old_problem: The historical review retained Pending, Source Conflict and BLOCKED because Items say STATUS_FAN 1~N while Criterion 5 requires STATUS_FAN1~16, and because a discrete removal/insertion status procedure is judged by copied temperature-threshold and protection criteria. It also required an authoritative fan map, event oracle and service/recovery procedure before any physical action.
disposition_reason: No source branch is discarded. Build a versioned applicability matrix over the union of every Project-defined STATUS_FAN index 1..N and every source-mandated logical index 1..16. Test every fitted/applicable fan; a non-fitted or unsupported logical position is N/A only with authoritative platform evidence, and N greater than 16 expands rather than truncates coverage. Separately execute (A) one-fan-at-a-time presence/status and SEL assert/deassert, (B) bounded normal thermal/control observation during each approved service action, and (C) the original threshold/SEL/protection requirements with an independently approved thermal stimulus and temperature-sensor matrix. Fan removal is not used to force a threshold. Standard IPMI supplies discovery/read/event mechanics; the exact population, SDR interpretation, event mapping, thermal limits, expected control response and service method are Project parameters that make execution NOT READY until supplied.
decision_basis: XLSX row 798, physical adjacent row 799, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. Row 798 is the sole Wistron-BMC-00088-V004 workbook identity; row 799 / variant 0298aa1a3c52a4e5 is the next missing formal queue case.

The union rule preserves both explicit source ranges: all Project-defined 1..N entries remain covered, every logical 1..16 entry receives an outcome, and an absent position is not silently passed. If Project N is below 16, the remaining source positions require SPEC-backed N/A; if N exceeds 16, positions above 16 remain mandatory.

IPMI v2.0 section 35.14 exposes current sensor reading/state and scanning/event-message status, while Full/Compact/Event-only SDR records define sensor owner/number, entity, sensor type, event/reading type, masks and ID string. High-level `ipmitool sdr elist` is therefore a valid discovery/read surface, but its displayed normal/absent/fault wording is not a universal OEM oracle.

IPMI v2.0 sections 40.1-40.2 distinguish explicit presence bits/sensors, FRU availability and active associated sensors. An Entity Presence sensor uses generic discrete event/reading type 08h for absent/present or 09h for disabled/enabled, but a platform may expose a fan-specific event model; the actual SDR and Project map control acceptance.

IPMI v2.0 SEL records preserve generator, sensor type/number, direction and event data. A corresponding textual SEL line is insufficient unless its raw record is decoded against the approved fan/status or temperature event map and correlated with the physical-action timestamp.

A discrete fan presence/status transition and a continuous temperature threshold crossing are different claims. A brief removal can show normal temperature and compensating peer-fan behavior without reaching any threshold; it cannot satisfy the copied threshold criteria. Conversely, a thermal fixture event cannot prove the named fan was removed and reinserted.

ED-02 preserves exact source identity; ED-03 and ED-13 permit a standard BMC contract but prohibit guessed OEM semantics; ED-15 requires authoritative proof for N/A; ED-17 and ED-25 keep thermal fixtures and hardware service operator-controlled; ED-18 and ED-30 prohibit an unapproved threshold verdict; ED-19 requires SEL evidence preservation; ED-20's general visual-evidence principle prevents a read-only query from replacing the physical state; ED-26 through ED-30 and ED-33 through ED-38 retain independent coverage, confirmation, recovery and verdict ownership.

test_case.test_name: STATUS_FAN union-population presence, SEL, thermal and protection validation
test_case.purpose: Verify every applicable Project fan status sensor across removal/reinsertion, preserve explicit STATUS_FAN1~16 coverage, correlate exact SEL assert/deassert and recovery, confirm bounded temperature and controller behavior during service, and independently verify every retained temperature threshold and specified protective response without treating one signal as evidence for another.
required_package: Versioned Project fan applicability matrix covering the union of 1..N and 1..16: logical STATUS_FAN label, physical chassis slot/module/rotor, FRU/entity, redundancy/cooling zone, fitted state, hot-swap/service capability, required outcome and authoritative reason for each N/A

BMC/SDR contract for each fan: owner/LUN/number/ID, SDR record/type, entity, sensor type, event/reading type, readable presence/status/RPM values, assertion/deassertion masks, normal/absent/fault states and exact raw SEL generator/sensor/event-data map

Supported read-only collection package: pinned `ipmitool`, validated source-script revision or approved parser, local/OOB transport, BMC/SDR/chassis/FRU versions, monotonic timestamp correlation and full SEL export/hash tooling; no invented raw write bytes

Vendor-approved one-module-at-a-time hot-swap or powered service SOP with trained operator, workload/service state, N+ redundancy and zone impact, removal dwell/reinsert timing, physical identification, ESD/mechanical controls, abort limits and recovery owner

Independent thermal matrix for the retained Criteria: mapped temperature sensor, SDR units/conversion, every applicable configured warning/critical threshold and hysteresis, expected SEL assertion/deassertion, fan-control/protection response, calibrated fixture/stimulus, safe ceiling and recovery. Unsupported thresholds require SPEC-backed N/A rather than omission

Per-action displayed approval and evidence plan for physical removal/reinsertion and for any threshold stimulus or expected shutdown; an approved OOB path is mandatory before a disruptive protection checkpoint
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED ATTENDED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Export/hash baseline SEL and host/BMC logs, inventory the union applicability matrix, capture raw SDR records plus `ipmitool sdr elist`, mapped RPM/status, temperature, redundancy, controller and host health. Do not clear logs. Checkpoint A, for each applicable fan independently: display the exact physical/logical mapping, service state, cooling margin, aborts and recovery; obtain immediate approval; a trained operator removes only that approved module by its vendor SOP while automation records synchronized status/RPM/peer-fan/temperature/health and raw SEL. Require the mapped absence/fault assertion, then reinsert/secure the module once and require present/normal deassertion plus full recovery before the next fan. Checkpoint B is evaluated from the same trace but independently: temperature remains within the approved service envelope and peer/controller behavior exactly matches Project policy; this is not threshold coverage. Checkpoint C, after restoring all fans, use only the separately approved thermal fixture/profile to cross and re-arm each applicable mapped temperature threshold one at a time; capture reading, event state, SEL and the specified controller response, including an authorized shutdown only where the Project matrix requires it and OOB recovery is ready. Never use fan removal merely to heat the system to a threshold, infer N, map a slot by label order, modify thresholds/fan policy, clear evidence, service two fans together, repeat an ambiguous action or issue a DUT verdict automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every union-matrix entry has an authoritative fitted/applicable test result or SPEC-backed N/A, with no truncation at 16 or assumption that N equals 16. Each applicable fan independently changes from mapped present/normal to absent/fault on removal, creates the exact assertion record, returns to present/normal on reinsertion, creates the expected deassertion/recovery evidence, and restores RPM, redundancy, temperature, controller and host/BMC health. Normal-service temperature and peer-fan compensation stay within Project limits. Separately, every applicable temperature threshold asserts/deasserts at the approved reading/hysteresis with its exact SEL record and prescribed fan-control, throttle or shutdown response, followed by successful recovery.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the complete union applicability matrix, all fitted/applicable fans tested one at a time, all source 1..16 positions accounted for, exact sensor-to-slot and raw SEL correlation, status assertion/deassertion, bounded thermal behavior, expected controller response, full reinsertion/recovery, and the separate complete threshold/protection matrix. A missing logical index, undocumented N/A, guessed label/order, static read only, textual SEL without raw-map correlation, threshold evidence substituted for fan status, fan removal substituted for a controlled threshold stimulus, absent deassertion, unexpected thermal/redundancy/host behavior, unapproved shutdown, evidence loss, retry or incomplete recovery cannot pass. Missing Project packages produce NOT READY, not Pending resolution or PASS; a platform defect is FAIL/BLOCKED for execution, not N/A.
safety_gate: Preserve and hash existing SEL and related logs before physical or thermal action; never clear diagnostic evidence for this test. Isolate test timestamps with markers rather than deleting history.

A trained human performs every removal/reinsertion and fixture operation. Automation is limited to approved read-only collection, correlation and bounded coordination; no robotic/remote physical substitution is claimed.

Confirm the exact module is serviceable in the chosen power state, remaining zone redundancy/cooling margin is sufficient, workload is approved and OOB recovery works. Non-hot-swappable hardware uses its vendor-required powered service state.

Only one mapped fan/module may be serviced at a time. Stop and reinsert immediately on wrong identity/state, redundant-fan loss, rapid or out-of-envelope temperature rise, unexpected peer response, throttle/shutdown, BMC/host instability, SEL mismatch or uncertain mechanics.

Threshold stimulus is a separate point-of-action approval with calibrated independent sensing, rate/dwell/ceiling limits and recovery owner. Never force temperature by leaving a fan absent or change BMC thresholds/fan policy to obtain an event.
No automatic retry. Preserve the first failure/ambiguous evidence and let the cooling/BMC owner choose recovery and any later rerun.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant, chassis/FRU/BMC/SDR/tool/script versions and signed union 1..N plus 1..16 applicability/N/A matrix
Per-fan raw SDR plus decoded owner/number/entity/type/event masks/map, physical slot/module photographs or operator evidence and approval/service timestamps
Hashed baseline/final SEL and logs; raw per-fan assertion/deassertion records decoded against the approved event map rather than textual status alone
Synchronized status, RPM, peer-fan, redundancy, temperature, controller, power and host/BMC traces across each removal, reinsertion and recovery
Separate temperature threshold/hysteresis matrix, calibrated fixture trace, raw sensor/event/SEL data and exact fan-control/throttle/shutdown response for every applicable threshold
Per-fan, normal-thermal, per-threshold and overall coverage/verdict records, all aborts/anomalies, secured hardware and final recovered baseline
test_case.recovery: On a fan-service anomaly, do not repeat or advance: preserve the live trace/SEL, stop the approved workload if directed, reinsert and secure the exact module when safe, restore required power/service state, and verify all fan presence/RPM, redundancy, temperatures, controller, BMC and host health through the OOB path. On a thermal-stimulus anomaly, stop the fixture, restore the approved environment/cooling, follow the Project shutdown/bring-up owner and preserve first-failure evidence. If a module cannot be reinserted, cooling does not recover, or identity/event mapping is uncertain, keep the system isolated and escalate; no automatic power cycle or additional hardware action is authorized by this review.

source_conflict.reason: The Review layer does not choose N or 16 and does not discard the copied thermal criteria. The union matrix accounts for both ranges, while discrete status, normal thermal response and threshold/protection behavior become independently passing checkpoints with distinct evidence.

blocked.reason: IPMI supplies authoritative generic presence/status/SDR/SEL mechanics and a complete safe test structure can be written. Project fan topology, OEM state/event interpretation, service envelope and thermal oracle are finite execution packages; their absence makes the parameterized case NOT READY rather than an unresolved engineering-semantics block.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Union fan population/applicability and N/A authority; exact fan/slot/FRU/SDR/status/RPM/SEL map; service/hot-swap/redundancy/load/thermal envelope; threshold/hysteresis/response matrix; fixture, OOB recovery, evidence and approval roles.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER HYBRID CASE ONLY; NO FAN, SENSOR, THERMAL, SEL, LOG, IPMI, POWER OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Sections 35.13-35.14 and SDR definitions establish sensor state/reading/event and identity fields; sections 40.1-40.2 distinguish explicit presence sensors/bits, FRU and active-sensor inference; sensor/event and SEL definitions support raw assertion/deassertion correlation without imposing OEM display strings.

project_authority: The Project platform, thermal and BMC owners approve the union applicability/N/A matrix, exact sensor/event oracle, vendor service method, safe thermal envelope, every threshold/protective response, fixture and OOB recovery. A trained operator performs physical/thermal actions and the owners issue per-checkpoint and overall verdicts; confirmation cannot make a missing fan, static read, inferred event, undocumented N/A, lost SEL or unexecuted threshold PASS.
